subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these specific upstream GitHub Action revisions for workflows that scan repository content, run CodeQL, and authenticate to container registries?
rationale: The diff is mechanically narrow, but it changes externally supplied executable code in credential-bearing and security-sensitive automation paths; that acceptance boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the reviewed revisions
options.body: After reviewing the upstream releases and a completed rebased check run, merge the SHA-pinned updates.

options.title: Hold the current pins
options.body: Keep the existing immutable revisions if the upstream release changes are not acceptable for OpenClaw’s CI and release trust boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept the reviewed revisions
recommendation.body: After reviewing the upstream releases and a completed rebased check run, merge the SHA-pinned updates.
